result.instructions: Tools for Eurosender, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What does it cost to send a 5 kg parcel from Berlin to Paris?"; "Which countries can Eurosender ship to?"; "Where is my latest Eurosender order right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Eurosender data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eurosender_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eurosender_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eurosender_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. eurosender_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eurosender_list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: List the countries Eurosender ships to and from, with flags for whether a city or region is required in an address. Call this first to learn the country codes. Eurosender API: GET /v1/countries.

tools.name: eurosender_list_cities
tools.title: List cities
tools.description: List the cities supported for pickup and delivery in one country. Use a city id in an address when the city name is not exact. Eurosender API: GET /v1/countries/{countryCode}/cities.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example DE.

tools.name: eurosender_list_regions
tools.title: List regions
tools.description: List the regions of one country. Use a region id or code in an address where the country needs one. Eurosender API: GET /v1/countries/{countryCode}/regions.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example DE.

tools.name: eurosender_get_quote
tools.title: Get a shipping quote
tools.description: Get the available service types, prices and add-ons for a shipment. Creates no order and books nothing. Prices are in EUR only. Use the returned serviceType in eurosender_validate_order and eurosender_create_order. Eurosender API: POST /v1/quotes.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example DE.

zip.description: ZIP or postal code. Most countries need it.

city.description: City name. Some countries require it. eurosender_list_countries shows which ones.

cityId.description: City id from eurosender_list_cities. Use it when the city name is not exact.

region.description: Region name, where the country needs one (see eurosender_list_regions).

regionCode.description: Region code, where the country needs one.

tools.name: eurosender_cancel_order
tools.title: Cancel an order
tools.description: CANCELS an existing order. Eurosender decides whether the cancel is allowed and what it costs. Check the order status with eurosender_get_tracking first. Eurosender API: DELETE /v1/orders/{orderCode}.

order_code.description: Eurosender order code, from the eurosender_create_order response.

tools.name: eurosender_get_tracking
tools.title: Get tracking
tools.description: Get the live tracking status and checkpoints of each parcel in an order. Eurosender API: GET /v1/orders/{orderCode}/tracking.

order_code.description: Eurosender order code, from the eurosender_create_order response.

tools.name: eurosender_get_order_labels
tools.title: Get shipping labels
tools.description: Download the shipping label PDF of an order, returned as base64 (max 524288 bytes). Larger labels are not returned. Eurosender API: GET /v1/orders/{orderCode}/labels.

order_code.description: Eurosender order code, from the eurosender_create_order response.
